thesis: Preserve compositionality and semantic freedom at the agent-facing surface; move mechanically exact complexity beneath it.

evidence: 191KB of replayed agent python across 166 blocks, all ordinary Python (openpyxl + pandas + re + zipfile + subprocess + stdlib)
284 search loops, 60 computed-coordinate uses, 60 cross-sheet patterns, 45 dimension loops, 17 formula writes, 351 cell writes, 20 saves (OPERATION_CENSUS corpus totals)
multi-step composed pipelines in every run (inspect -> compute -> write -> verify; unzip -> grep -> python -> LO-recalc -> re-read)
zero spontaneous demand for a Recalc-specific higher-level abstraction in 18 runs
O-family XML-surgery workflows (r02/r14/r18) route AROUND openpyxl with plain re/zipfile rather than demanding richer APIs — compositional escape, not abstraction demand
working-helper stratum (12 O runs, container-verified callable): 0 imports, 0 calls despite 3 write-eligible runs and universal search/inspection demand
broken-helper stratum (6 P runs): 2 spontaneous search calls showing latent interest, both failed on D1 (ModuleNotFoundError), 0 successes; both models continued in ordinary openpyxl without retry
write-family helpers: 0 calls given 6 eligible runs; plan artifacts: 0 genuine (1 miner flag adjudicated false positive: markdown bullets in analysis prose)
reopen rule requires adoption AND benefit; both prongs absent in the measurable stratum
median largest single observation 5.4KB; python-observation totals P-max 8.5KB vs O-max 154KB (r18)
heaviest O runs still filter before emitting: r18 full-sheet traversal -> files -> grep -> 154KB total over 42 steps; r06 full iteration -> head-60; r14 dumps -> sed/grep slices
largest agent-viewed single obs 65KB (r18) caused no measurable harm; 58.6KB harness view_xlsx dumps (r07/r08) preceded exact successes
no run failed from context pressure (failures are call/time/cost/format); no context-limit errors in 18 runs
C_observation_sparsity.limitation: O-family absolute verbosity is ~10-20x P-family without measurable harm at these scales; the sparsity thesis survives structurally (filter-before-emit in both families) but O's higher emission volume is a model-family caveat

evidence: 165 runtime-usable blocks: base 122.8s vs recalc 125.3s; Recalc-owned phases total ~3.6s (reference parse 3.2s + artifact load 0.3s); remainder is ordinary-Python execution (openpyxl ops, user logic, LO subprocesses)
admitted path served 13,989 direct reads + 9,302 iteration cells + 349 iteration rows on 10 loads
no block's cost traces to a missing agent-facing operation; non-admission blockers are designed-out categories (mixed read/write, dynamic uncertainty, escape, data_only, rich)
structural generalization holds (preregistered: not numerical identity with R7)
D_subsurface_cost.note: paired same-window measurement; Tier 1 is not a speedup claim

evidence: 18/165 usable blocks admitted (11%; 13% of the 136 read-only blocks), 8/18 runs touched; admitted wall 9.6s
non-admission is by-design fail-closed: mixed read/write dominant, then static uncertainty, escape, data_only, rich/worksheets

single-family wall audit: uncertain 18.9s (no static boundary possible), data_only 14.5s/11 blocks (boundary not credible: stale-cache ambiguity per Phase-12 lineage), write-ish 8.8s (mutation engine out of scope), rich/worksheets ~1s each; iter-shape NEVER appears alone (always co-blocked) -> no read-expansion family earns reopen
zero admission errors; 8 DIRECT_WITH_FALLBACK blocks show runtime fail-closed working
E_direct_coverage.limitation: raw natural-behavior coverage is modest (11% blocks); the contract covers its simple-read target fully but most natural agent code is mixed/dynamic by construction. data_only is the largest adjacent demand and stays closed on semantic risk, not lack of demand.

evidence: 11 non-exact runs forensically classified (FAILURE_BOUNDARY.jsonl): 5 show reasoning/action errors with deciding evidence verified in context (r01 precedents, r03 sheet, r05 structure, r16 C14, r04 disengagement-with-evidence-available)
0 failures trace to missing mechanical evidence (the key falsifier never appeared across 2 new model families)
5 budget terminations carry no signal either way (3 O timeouts incl. 1 latency-driven post-save r10, 2 O call-limits incl. on-track r18, 3 P cost-caps with reasoning errors visible in partials)
1 evaluation ambiguity (r24: spec-compliant dynamic flags vs static-string golden; frozen, not rescored)
